message:
Running command: cd /workspace/pocwork && cat > rawsan.cnf <<'EOF'
[req]
distinguished_name=req_dn
x509_extensions=v3_req
prompt=no
[req_dn]
CN=localhost
[v3_req]
2.5.29.17=DER:302A820D66697273742E6578616D706C65A00A06082B06010505070804820D74686972642E6578616D706C65
basicConstraints=CA:false
EOF
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:1024 -nodes -keyout rawkey.pem -out rawcert.pem -outform PEM -days 1 -config rawsan.cnf -sha256 >/tmp/ossl2.log 2>&1 && openssl x509 -in rawcert.pem -outform DER -out rawcert.der && wc -c rawcert.der && openssl asn1parse -inform DER -in rawcert.der -i | grep -A6 -B2 'X509v3 Subject Alternative Name' || (cat /tmp/ossl2.log; exit 1)
